headline: The shade has reached the chair leg.
body: The bright patch from noon has slid past the floorboard and gone under the bookcase. A bus stops below, doors open, and no one gets off. The blotter still holds the ring of a cup lifted an hour ago.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: thin high cloud, light still white

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: chair leg in shade, sill holding a strip

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: bus idling, doors shut again, no horn
